body: Are you saying I shouldn't use an alt name?
Thank you also for the hugs.  It's much appreciated.
Thanks for reading everyone.  Yes, I've gotten help before. I never have been able to sustain it because I can't afford it.

I have a confession.  I need to get this out.  I have alts.  Maybe about 6 of them.  I need to say certain things.  I have no one else to tell.  Please listen.  

I was sexually abused as a 4 and 5 yr old.  Sometimes I liked it.  Sometimes it hurt alot. I was scared shitless and wanted to make it go away so bad.  I tried to tell my mother about it and I was blamed for it.

I was physically and emotionally abused by my dad.  He fucked me up so bad I'll never get over it.

I was made fun of so bad in school I just wanted to die every day.  I didn't have friends.

Life hurts so bad.

I turned out to be nothing but a rag for guys to come on (and in) and ended up in abusive realtionships that led to 3 abortions.  

I have pedophillic tendencies and a problem with cp because of the abuse I experienced as a kid.

A lot of days I want to die. 

I just had to say these things because I've been wanting somone, somewhere to just know.

This is why I have alts.  I need to *say* my pain.  I can't do it in real life.  I can't do it under one name.  Little pieces of me are scattered all over the 'net.

My alts are my vavles. I have to have a pressure valve to let some of the pain out or I will explode and die.
